topics.title: Population genomics and phylogenomics with SNP data
topics.summary: Step-by-step tutorials, with simple scripts, for analysing RAD-seq or DArTseq data of closely related populations and species: from the raw reads to the population structure, the relationships between groups and the tests of gene flow. Written for students, on a Linux server without administrator access, with conda and RStudio.

parts.series: Part 1 · From raw reads to population structure
parts.summary: Follow the tutorials in order: the output of each one is the input of the next. From quality control of the raw reads to SNP calling, filtering, diversity, clustering and maps of gene flow.
Infer the relationships between populations or species and test for hybridization and gene flow, starting from the filtered VCF of Part 1. More tutorials are coming.
